rules: Order is priority. An agent changes only its own task's status, to done, in the pull request that lands it. Statuses: todo (pickable), in-review (a named session lands it), done, architect (any agent writes the packet first, D-109), owner (waits on the owner). A task whose dependency is not done gets no work at all until it is (D-134). Run `node scripts/next-task.mjs`.
